mapper.insert: insert into location_nerp select sku, qty from stg_location_nerp;

insert into location select location, item, description, inv_status, quantity, SUBSTRING_INDEX(creation_date, ' ', 1) from stg_location where inv_status = 'CP' and (left(location,1) ='1' or left(location,1) ='0');

insert into sku_category values
(#{i.sku},#{i.category},#{i.description})
on DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE category = Values(category)
mapper.select: select b.item, least(ifnull(a.qty,0) + 0,b.qty + 0) as min_qty,c.category,ifnull(c.description, b.description) as `description`,max_creation as creation_date from location_nerp a right join (select item, description,sum(quantity) as qty, max(creation_date) as max_creation from location group by item,description) b on a.sku = b.item left join sku_category c on a.sku = c.sku;

select category,sum(min_qty) as min_qty from ( select b.item, least(ifnull(a.qty,0),b.qty) as min_qty,c.category from location_nerp a right join (select item, sum(quantity) as qty from location group by item) b on a.sku = b.item left join sku_category c on a.sku = c.sku) x group by category;
